name: Model-only / single turn
label: model-only
description: 无外部 agent loop；保留 prompt、shots、解码和 reasoning 设置。

name: Provider-reported (harness unspecified)
label: 未注明 harness
description: 来源报告了结果但没有足够信息确定执行器；不得与固定 harness 的结果做 exact 比较。

name: SWE-bench official harness
label: SWE-bench official
description: 官方 SWE-bench evaluator；实例、补丁应用和测试环境按 benchmark 版本固定。

name: SWE-agent
label: SWE-agent
description: Repository-level coding-agent scaffold; version, tool policy, timeout and benchmark checker remain part of each protocol.

name: mini-SWE-agent
label: mini-SWE-agent
description: 轻量 coding agent scaffold；记录版本、timeout、temperature 和 rollout 聚合。

name: Terminus-2
label: Terminus-2
description: Terminal-Bench 常见终端 agent；不同版本和 effort 是不同 protocol。

name: Claude Code
label: Claude Code
description: Claude Code CLI/agent scaffold；记录版本、权限、工具和上下文管理。

name: Codex harness
label: Codex
description: Codex/Responses coding agent scaffold；应记录 effort、sandbox、tools 和 timeout。

name: Kimi Code
label: Kimi Code
description: Kimi 官方 coding harness；K3 官方 benchmark 明确使用该 harness。

name: DeepSeek Harness
label: DeepSeek Harness
description: DeepSeek V4 Flash 官方 agent 评测 harness；官方更新注明 minimal mode/max effort。

name: EleutherAI lm-evaluation-harness
label: lm-eval
description: 静态 benchmark runner；记录 commit、task config、shots 和 generation 参数。

name: Vendor default evaluator
label: 厂商默认
description: 厂商模型卡中的默认评测设置；作为 reported/conditional，不推断具体 agent。

name: Arena human-preference rating
label: Arena human preference
description: Arena pairwise human-vote aggregation; rating, CI, votes and category stay attached to each snapshot.

name: Arena Agent IPS evaluator
label: Arena Agent IPS
description: Arena Agent published IPS (tau-hat) score; not interchangeable with Bradley-Terry Elo or model-only runs.

name: Agents' Last Exam evaluator
label: ALE
description: ALE-V1 sandbox/evaluator; source agent harness (Codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code, ALE-Claw and others) and effort variant remain in each run's protocol.

name: Berkeley Function Calling evaluator
label: BFCL evaluator
description: BFCL V4 evaluator；必须区分 native function calling（FC）与 prompt workaround，并记录固定 evaluator commit。
